personality_one_liner: A high-performance, command-center aesthetic with deep obsidian surfaces, aggressive red accents, and high-impact condensed typography tailored for automotive workshop efficiency.

spacing.rule: Use an 8pt grid system. Keep vertical rhythms tight in data cards but comfortable for touch targets (min 44pt). Maintain generous safe-area margins.

dont's: Do not use glassmorphism. This is a dark-first utility app for automotive workflows. Solid dark surfaces are required for high contrast and readability in shop floor conditions.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry point showcasing the brand identity and aesthetic.

states.loading: Dark screen with red spinning indicator

screens.layout: Full-bleed dark automotive background with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Form sits at the bottom 40%. Large primary CTA button.

screens.name: Dashboard (Início)

screens.purpose: Track warranty status for services and parts.
screens.layout: Filter chips for Vigente (Green), Próxima (Yellow), Vencida (Red). List of warranty cards detailing the service, OS reference, and expiration date.

screens.name: Mais (Mecânicos, Relatórios, Configurações)
screens.layout: Simple vertical list of navigation rows (Mecânicos, Relatórios, Configurações) with leading tinted icon containers and trailing chevrons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility DARK guidelines. Use black as the dominant color (#050505) with red accents (#D32F2F) as requested by the user.
Implement a 4-tab bottom navigation: Início, OS, Caixa, Mais.
Use Phosphor icons with filled weights for active tabs and regular weights for inactive ones.
OS status requires strict color coding: Orçamento (Orange), Em Execução (Blue), Concluída (Green), Cancelada (Red), Aguardando (Gray), Entregue (Light Green).
Garantias status visual indicators: Vigente (Green), Próxima do vencimento (Yellow/Warning), Vencida (Red/Error).
Avoid unnecessary animations. Keep transitions instant or very fast to suit the professional, operational nature of the app.
Ensure all forms are divided into logical sections (e.g., Dados do Veículo, Peças, Serviços, Pagamento) to prevent scrolling fatigue.
Use touch targets of at least 44x44pt. Mechanics use the app in rugged environments, so buttons and list items must be easily tappable.
Ensure the login screen features the provided `login_hero` image with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim to ensure form readability at the bottom.
Format currency as 'R$' and dates as 'DD/MM/AAAA' everywhere.
